integrity: Mathematical proof and deterministic finite checks supplied. No claim of validation by an independent reviewer, formal proof system, or comprehensive priority search.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional normalized streaming Kaczmarz only; per-indicator-independent Bernoulli corruption; jointly adaptive Massart amplitudes bounded by B times the current nonzero scalar error; exact projections; tie acceptance. The motivating high-dimensional theorem assumes at least two dimensions. The two-term batch-size law has fixed beta and q and B tending to infinity.
title: Sharp one-step minimax mean-square risk of scalar streaming quantile Kaczmarz under Massart corruption
